addPlant.title: Register New Plant
addPlant.subtitle: Initialize phenological and microclimate monitoring for a specific crop
addPlant.plantNameHelp: A memorable identifier such as 'Tomato Plot Alpha' or 'Greenhouse Bed 3'.
addPlant.cropTypeHelp: Select the botanical crop family. PlantPulse AI supports Tomato, Chilli, Brinjal, Okra, Cucumber, and Banana.
addPlant.cropVarietyHelp: Specific cultivar or hybrid name, e.g. 'Arka Rakshak' or 'Pusa Ruby'.
addPlant.plantingDateHelp: The calendar date when seeds were sown or nursery seedlings were transplanted.
addPlant.locationHelp: Geographical or farm plot identifier, e.g. 'North Field - Polyhouse 2'.
addPlant.descriptionHelp: Optional notes regarding soil type, basal fertilizer, or irrigation method.
addPlant.initialPhotoHelp: Upload a clear daylight photograph showing whole plant foliage and stem.
